description: Record a move: one action toward the aim with no duration, e.g. a small fix the user described to you from the phone, or a message sent. task says what changed, in plain words. Classified like a session (pass leverId, stepId, itemId or projectId when known). Past days are fine (date). completes_item: true with item_id ticks that plan item, so a move can finish the main step. Counts toward the weekly target. Use it for work that had no timer; use add_session for timed work.

completes_item.description: true: this move finishes the plan item item_id (and its path step)

date.description: default today; a past day for a move done then

task.description: what changed, e.g. "fixed the signup button text on the landing page"

name: add_move
title: Add move
